papers.title: Coaxial 3D bioprinting of self-assembled multicellular heterogeneous tumor fibers
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting of living structures with cell-laden biomaterials has been achieved in vitro, however, some cell-cell interactions are limited by the existing hydrogel. To better mimic tumor microenvironment, self-assembled multicellular heterogeneous brain tumor fibers have been fabricated by a custom-made coaxial extrusion 3D bioprinting system, with high viability, proliferative activity and efficient tumor-stromal interactions. Therein, in order to further verify the sufficient interactions between tumor cells and stroma MSCs, CRE-LOXP switch gene system which contained GSCs transfected with "LOXP-STOP-LOXP-RFP" genes and MSCs transfected with "CRE recombinase" gene was used. Results showed that tumor-stroma cells interacted with each other and fused, the transcription of RFP was higher than that of 2D culture model and control group with cells mixed directly into alginate, respectively. RFP expression was observed only in the cell fibers but not in the control group under confocal microscope. In conclusion, coaxial 3D bioprinted multicellular self-assembled heterogeneous tumor tissue-like fibers provided preferable 3D models for studying tumor microenvironment in vitro, especially for tumor-stromal interactions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于同轴生物打印构建肿瘤模型，但未涉及人工智能方法，与AI生物打印方向相关性很低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper lacks any AI/ML integration into the bioprinting workflow, no computational model, and no autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建仿生肿瘤微环境的体外模型
summary_zh.method: 同轴挤出打印含肿瘤和基质细胞的海藻酸纤维
summary_zh.result: 细胞存活率高，肿瘤-基质相互作用有效
summary_zh.validation: 共聚焦显微镜和CRE-LOXP基因系统验证

summary_en.motivation: To create in vitro tumor models that better mimic the native microenvironment for studying cell-cell interactions.
summary_en.method: Coaxial extrusion bioprinting was used to fabricate cell-laden alginate fibers containing tumor and stromal cells, enabling self-assembly into multicellular heterogeneous structures.
summary_en.result: The printed fibers exhibited high cell viability, proliferation, and enhanced tumor-stromal interactions, as confirmed by RFP expression.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using confocal microscopy and a CRE-LOXP genetic switch system to confirm cell fusion and interaction.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与髋关节假体应力遮挡、微动或接触力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on taper corrosion and fretting at the head-neck junction, not on femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同锥度设计的腐蚀和磨损表现。
summary_zh.method: 实验检测12/14锥度配合的腐蚀和微动。
summary_zh.result: 不同锥度组合腐蚀程度有差异。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量腐蚀和磨损数据。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the corrosion and fretting behavior of different taper designs in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Experimental evaluation of 12/14 stem and head tapers for corrosion and fretting damage.
summary_en.result: Significant differences in corrosion and fretting damage were observed among taper combinations.
summary_en.validation: In vitro testing with measurement of corrosion and fretting scores.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床手术入路比较，未涉及任何生物力学或植入物设计内容。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanics modeling, no implant design, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较直接前入路与Hardinge入路在全髋置换术中的临床结果和患者满意度。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析社区医院中两种手术入路的患者数据。
summary_zh.result: 两种入路在临床结果和满意度上无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床随访数据的统计比较。

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction between direct anterior approach and Hardinge approach in primary total hip arthroplasty at a community hospital.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of patient data comparing two surgical approaches.
summary_en.result: No significant differences in clinical outcomes and satisfaction were found between the two approaches.
summary_en.validation: Statistical comparison of clinical follow-up data.
